name: Panoptis
label: Panoptis (defense analytics)
tagline: Your code will help 'keep people safe'. Which people is a later question.
lockedReason: Requires a passed coding interview, a tech internship or Math & AI ≥ 55

footprint.label: Panoptis data centres (work footprint, design estimate)

effects.text: Your badge opens doors you didn't know existed. Some of them should probably stay closed.

name: InfiniScroll
label: InfiniScroll (social media)
hint: Build the feed everyone hates to love
tagline: Connecting people, one more scroll at a time.
lockedReason: Requires the AI club, a tech internship, a following or Math & AI ≥ 45

footprint.label: InfiniScroll recommendation engine (work footprint, design estimate)

effects.text: Your first project: make people scroll four seconds longer. You succeed. Somewhere, a teenager misses their bus stop.

name: Nebulary
label: Nebulary (cloud & AI platform)
hint: Servers as far as the eye can see
tagline: Your data, our cloud, everyone's electricity bill.
lockedReason: Requires a tech internship, a coding interview or Math & AI ≥ 40

footprint.label: Nebulary data centre expansion (work footprint, design estimate)

effects.text: You get a hoodie, a badge and access to a data centre the size of a small town. It hums like it knows something.

name: Tramontane AI
label: Tramontane AI (frontier lab)
tagline: Building Europe's smartest model. Also its largest electricity contract.
lockedReason: Requires a PhD, Math & AI ≥ 65, or a passed coding interview with Math & AI ≥ 55 and Intelligence ≥ 45

footprint.label: Tramontane training runs (work footprint, design estimate)

effects.text: Forty researchers, a whiteboard full of scaling laws and a coffee machine that costs more than your car. The press calls you 'the European answer'.

name: Hexagone AI Lab
label: Hexagone AI Lab (public research)
tagline: Open science, open questions, closed coffee machine (broken since forever).

effects.text: Postdoc, then permanent researcher. Your salary is modest, your office has a plant, and your code is open for the whole world to criticise.

name: Cassiopée Health Lab
label: Cassiopée Health Lab (health economics)
tagline: We put numbers on health so nobody has to guess.
lockedReason: Requires a Master's, a PhD or a lab internship

effects.text: Your first model, as the most junior analyst on the team, decides where three new MRI machines go. You check the code nine times.

name: Goldbridge
label: Goldbridge (investment bank)
tagline: Money never sleeps. Neither will you.
lockedReason: Requires a bank internship, or a Master's and a passed quant test

effects.text: Analyst, year one. Your first bonus could buy a small car. Your first month could break a small horse.

name: Hedgehog Partners
label: Hedgehog Partners (quant fund)
tagline: We beat the market. The market has not been informed.
lockedReason: Requires a passed quant test, or a finance background and Math & AI ≥ 50

effects.text: Your model trades in microseconds. Your lunch break is still forty-five minutes and you resent it.

name: Leafline Capital
label: Leafline Capital (ESG funds)
tagline: Sustainable finance, sustainably profitable.
lockedReason: Requires a finance club, the Impact asso or Economics ≥ 40

effects.text: Your fund is 'Article 9, dark green'. One of its holdings drills in the Arctic. Very sustainably.

name: Sterling & Pike
label: Sterling & Pike (strategy consulting)
hint: Eighty slides, three countries a week
tagline: We'll tell you what you already know, in 80 slides.
lockedReason: Requires a consulting internship, or a Master's and a passed case interview

effects.text: Junior business analyst: Monday in Frankfurt, Wednesday in Madrid, Friday in a hotel lobby that looks exactly like Monday's.

name: Synergeia Advisory
label: Synergeia Advisory (audit & consulting)
tagline: Synergies identified. Headcount optimised. Invoice attached.

effects.text: You are given a laptop, a methodology and a client who hates you on principle. It's a start.

name: Geneva Council on AI
label: Geneva Council on AI (intl agency)
tagline: Making sure the robots sign the treaty too.
lockedReason: Requires a policy internship, a passed policy panel, or an AI asso with Charisma ≥ 40 and Intelligence ≥ 45

effects.text: Your first job is a footnote in an annex of a draft. It is the most argued-over footnote in Geneva.

name: Terra Accord Secretariat
label: Terra Accord (climate agency)
tagline: Saving the planet, one bracketed paragraph at a time.
lockedReason: Requires a policy internship, or the Impact asso and Charisma ≥ 35

effects.text: Your first summit lasts two extra nights. The final text removes one bracket. Everyone applauds, exhausted.

name: Maison Lumière
label: Maison Lumière (luxury group)
tagline: Selling timelessness, refreshed every season.
lockedReason: Requires a strategy internship or Economics ≥ 35

effects.text: You build a pricing model for a handbag that costs as much as your first car. It sells out.

name: Hyperbox
label: Hyperbox (e-commerce giant)
tagline: Next-day delivery. Next-day regret.

effects.text: Your algorithm shaves eleven minutes off delivery times. Nobody asked the drivers how they feel about it.

name: Petrolia
label: Petrolia (oil & gas major)
tagline: Powering progress since before you were born. And after.

footprint.label: Your share of Petrolia's operations (work footprint, design estimate)

effects.text: Your welcome pack includes a fleece, a fountain pen and a glossy report on 'the energy transition'. The pen is the most sincere part.

name: Voltaire Grid
label: Voltaire Grid (renewables & grid)
tagline: Plugging France into the future, one permit at a time.
lockedReason: Requires an energy internship, the Impact asso or Math & AI ≥ 35

effects.text: Your first wind farm takes four years of permits and one afternoon to switch on. You cry a little. It's windy.

name: Verdant
label: Verdant (impact NGO)
hint: Save the world on a shoestring
tagline: Saving the world on a shoestring budget.
lockedReason: Requires an NGO internship, the Impact asso or a gap year

effects.text: Your desk is a door on two trestles. Your work keeps a river clean. You would not trade.

name: Common Ground
label: Common Ground (social enterprise)
hint: Profit with a purpose, mostly purpose
tagline: Profit with a purpose. Mostly purpose.
lockedReason: Requires an NGO internship, a gap year or Impact ≥ 56

effects.text: You help long-term unemployed people repair laptops and sell them refurbished. Everyone wins, slowly.

name: Sprout Labs
label: Sprout Labs (seed-stage startup)
hint: Six people, one dog, short runway
tagline: Six people, one dog, infinite runway (approx. nine months).
lockedReason: Requires a startup internship, a startup asso or a Big Tech internship

effects.text: You are employee number seven. Your title is 'founding engineer, growth, also the printer'.

name: La Ferme des Communs
label: La Ferme des Communs (farm co-op)
tagline: No Wi-Fi. Excellent tomatoes.

effects.text: Your classmates send salary screenshots. You send a photo of a tomato. Yours gets more likes.
